reason: The late-supplier problem is real, I paid for premium freight last quarter. But I would not send PO, job and inventory exports from our plant to a startup I have never worked with before I have checked it with IT and our planners, and our shortage report already shows which jobs a late PO hits.
objection: Why would I give an outside team our open-PO and material data when our shortage tracker and Epicor Time Phase already tell me which jobs a late PO hits? I would need to see that they catch something my team misses, and I would need IT and security to sign off on sending data outside the company.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from an Epicor Kinetic shop my size that the audit caught a supplier date change their planners had missed, plus IT approval of the data handling.
